standard_prerequisites.use: Modules of differentials of a morphism, presentations of a morphism of algebraic spaces, and the universal property of the module of differentials; the comparison is retained.

core_obligations: Write down the two modules of differentials on the common chart and construct the natural comparison map between them.
Verify that the comparison is an isomorphism by checking the two composites are the identity.

proof_roadmap.step: Reduce to a common chart and write the two modules of differentials explicitly.
Construct the comparison map from the universal properties.
Verify the comparison is an isomorphism.

difficulty_reason: The lemma compares the modules of differentials attached to two presentations of the same morphism and shows that the two agree after the natural identification, which is the technical step that makes the sheaf of differentials well defined for algebraic spaces. The proof passes to a chart, writes down both modules explicitly in terms of the presentations, constructs the comparison isomorphism from the universal property of each, and verifies the two composites are the identity. Constructing and checking the comparison map is the substance. Retained author proof at lines 879-942.
